census.label: Final owned-native settlement census (before the17:57 native-end deadline)
census.format: ps -ww, comm last-column and args separate PID-map (untruncated)
census.limit: Recognized scientific executable names plus known owned-PID monitors; not a complete historical process-cap proof or ownership proof for arbitrary unknown processes. Two ps snapshots may race; absent/reused PID requires fresh identity validation before signalling.

scoped_cwd_scan.method: User-owned process cwd inspection with lsof; only exact six-lane/RUN cwd matches retained. Arguments are not printed, only SHA256 and expected-known-script test.
scoped_cwd_scan.limit: Current cwd snapshot supplements argv/native-name census; no historical-cap claim. Unknown or reused PIDs require independent ownership evidence before signal.

scope: Recognized scientific executables (untruncated names) plus every user-owned process whose cwd lies in RUN or any six-lane evidence tree. Observed before the17:57 native-end deadline; science closed17:30:11; no owned native/scientific work remains. Not a historical process-cap proof.
